ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) base pixels across ~85% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters forming ~15% of the surface area primarily through focal scarring and edge colonization.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white linear clusters located at distal left region; scattered circular white rings and irregular white blotches concentrated on the central and right lobes; dense white-to-cream barnacle clusters anchored at the extreme lateral tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 72 degrees and a vertical depth comprising ~12% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extreme high-amplitude irregularities on the right lobe trailing edge with deep, jagged pixel-voids; the left lobe displays lower-frequency serrations with more rounded peaks; both edges show significant deviation from a smooth linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: General convex curvature of the upper edge interrupted by significant topographic erosion on the right distal side and irregular serrations on the left.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast ring-scars visible on right lobe, including a prominent 'target' rosette at approximate center-right; dense clusters of roughly circular barnacle attachments on both lateral edges.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct parallel white linear marks (rake marks) visible on the left distal tip and trailing edge; multiple unaligned white scratches across the upper mid-section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe irregular tissue loss (notching) on the right lobe trailing edge; extensive barnacle encrustation on lateral termini; dense rake mark scarring throughout the upper regions of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique concentric circular scar on right lobe with a defined central point; severe jagged 'saw-tooth' erosion pattern specifically on the right-hand trailing edge.
